data.description:
## Testing Mode: GREEN

Create plugins/dso/scripts/check-sprint-trailer.sh — pre-commit hook that validates DSO-Story trailer presence when DSO_SPRINT_MODE=1 is set.

## Story DD Coverage
- DD1: Rejects trailer-less commits in sprint mode
- DD2: Passes when not in sprint mode (DSO_SPRINT_MODE unset)

## Script Logic

1. If DSO_SPRINT_MODE is unset or empty: exit 0 (no enforcement)
2. Get the latest commit message: git log -1 --format=%B
3. Parse trailers: git log -1 --format=%B | git interpret-trailers --parse
4. Check if any trailer key matches 'DSO-Story' (case-insensitive if needed, but prefer exact match of 'DSO-Story' per 170b-2ac9's format)
5. If DSO-Story trailer absent:
   - emit to stderr: 'ERROR: check-sprint-trailer: DSO-Story trailer required in sprint mode but not found in commit message. Run /dso:commit from within the story worktree to inject the trailer automatically.'
   - exit 1
6. If DSO-Story trailer present: exit 0

## Notes

- Use set -euo pipefail
- Use REPO_ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) if needed for config reads
- Must use git interpret-trailers --parse (NOT grep/awk) to detect the trailer — byte-for-byte format match with apply-attribution-trailers.sh
- chmod +x immediately after creation (CLAUDE.md always-do rule 11)

## File Impact

### Files to Create
- plugins/dso/scripts/check-sprint-trailer.sh

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Script exists at plugins/dso/scripts/check-sprint-trailer.sh and is executable
- [ ] Script exits 0 when DSO_SPRINT_MODE unset
- [ ] Script exits 1 with error message containing 'DSO-Story' when sprint mode active + trailer absent
- [ ] Script exits 0 when sprint mode active + trailer present
- [ ] Script uses git interpret-trailers --parse (not grep) for detection
- [ ] T1 RED tests pass GREEN (PASSED: 3  FAILED: 0, exit 0)
- [ ] ShellCheck passes with no errors

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus
On 3 consecutive opus failures: escalate to user
